A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete CoSD paper, including equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–B. All material is readable, and pages 2–12 render identically.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, ablations, efficiency measurements, and case studies in Section 4 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results in Section 4 and Appendix B, including benchmark scores, efficiency measurements, and three-model collaboration results.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 are identical. Draft generation, parallel verification, rule-based replacement, decision-tree training, and handling of different tokenizers are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use MMLU, GSM8K, HumanEval, Hellaswag, TruthfulQA, and AlpacaEval with the same training/evaluation roles. The four fusion scenarios and Appendix B experiments are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical: standalone models, Speculative Decoding, Average Decoding, and Co-LLM in Table 2; standalone models and Char-ED in Table 3. Appendix comparisons are also unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported settings are identical, including model pairings, tinyBenchmarks use, tree-training sample counts, hyperparameters, efficiency metrics, and Appendix B output-length settings.

E4.justification: The hyperparameter sensitivity study in Figure 2, training-dataset ablation in Table 5, iteration analysis in Table 7, and GSM8K/MMLU case studies are unchanged. Appendix B adds no new analysis.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version specifies repeated-run counts or random seeds, or reports confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative examples in Tables 2–10 and Figure 2 are identical. No scores, timings, iteration counts, rankings, or result entries are added, removed, or revised.

T1.justification: The problem formulation, generation and verification equations, and decision-tree objective in Equations (1)–(7) are unchanged. Neither appendix introduces new mathematical reasoning or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about efficient knowledge fusion, transferability, interpretability, and accuracy improvements of up to 10%.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and Appendices A–B are identical, including limitations when one similarly sized model dominates and when confidence-based replacement overrides a correct draft token.

D1.justification: The same tokenization instructions, decision-tree training details, hyperparameters, and model configurations are documented. No implementation, hardware, or code/data-access information is added or revised.

R1.justification: Section 2, citations, and the reference list are identical. Positioning relative to model fusion, collaborative decoding, and speculative decoding is unchanged.

P1.justification: The first-page author spelling changes from 'Muneeza Azmart' to 'Muneeza Azmat', and the arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 11 February 2025 to v2 dated 19 March 2025. Scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–2 and Tables 1–10 retain identical displays, captions, formatting, and placement. There is no figure, table, or document-layout revision beyond the first-page text edits covered under P1.

improvement.justification: The author-name spelling correction and updated arXiv stamp are editorial changes. Scientific content, empirical evidence, limitations, and reproducibility information—including both appendices—are identical, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
